newsitem.title: FRANCE: Havas says uninterested in Ciby 2000.
newsitem.headline: Havas says uninterested in Ciby 2000.

text.p: French communications company Havas is not interested in buying film production company Ciby 2000, a unit of construction giant Bouygues, a Havas spokesman said on Thursday.
Havas has "studied and has no interest" in Ciby 2000, the spokesman told Reuters.
French media have reported that Bouygues was trying to sell Ciby, which has produced The Piano, Underground and Secrets and Lies.
The U.S. entertainment newspaper Daily Variety has mentioned News Corp as another possible suitor.
